objetos_reliquias.efecto_literal: For traits, each of your Normal Pokémon also counts as one of the enemy team's types: the most common enemy type goes to your first Normal Pokémon, the next most common to the second, and so on.

observaciones.valor_observado: Cursed relic from the Gym Challenge badge rules: at fight start your lead gets −2 Speed. It can't be removed.
observaciones.contexto: Difiere del traspaso (−50% daño de enemigos más rápidos). Prevalece la UI actual; revisar 'i' de la carta en partida.

observaciones.valor_observado: Shiny Charm: completar Pokédex Gen 1, dobla tasa shiny. Aurora Charm: completar Pokédex completa (721), 1 de cada 5 shinies es Aurora en lugar de 1 de cada 10.
